def mask_email(value):
    local, _, domain = value.partition('@')
    return local[:1] + '***@' + domain

from app.db import get_session

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()


class AuditLogMixin:
    def fingerprint(self, value):
        return hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]


class CustomerAudit(AuditLogMixin):
    def record(self, customer_id, email):
        logger.info(
            'customer audit id=%s email_fp=%s',
            customer_id,
            self.fingerprint(email),
        )


async def customer_stream(session):
    result = await session.execute(select(Customer))
    for customer in result.scalars():
        yield customer


@router.get('/customers/stream')
async def stream_customers(session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)):
    audit = CustomerAudit()
    async for customer in customer_stream(session):
        audit.record(customer.id, customer.email)
        yield {'id': customer.id}

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.crm.repository import ConsentRepository, CustomerRepository
from app.db import get_session

RETENTION_DAYS = 365
router = APIRouter()


async def purge_session(session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)):
    yield session


async def purge_repository(repo, cutoff):
    await repo.hard_delete_before(cutoff)


@router.post('/internal/customers/purge')
async def purge_customers(session: AsyncSession = Depends(purge_session)):
    cutoff = timezone.now() - timedelta(days=RETENTION_DAYS)
    customers = CustomerRepository(session)

        purge_repository(consents, cutoff),
    )
    return {'purged_before': cutoff.isoformat()}

from datetime import timedelta

from django.forms import modelformset_factory
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.utils import timezone
from django.views import View

from app.billing.models import Invoice

PURGE_AFTER_DAYS = 2190

InvoiceFormSet = modelformset_factory(Invoice, fields=('number',), extra=0)


class InvoicePurgeView(View):
    def post(self, request):
        formset = InvoiceFormSet(request.POST, queryset=Invoice.objects.all())
        if not formset.is_valid():
            return JsonResponse({'errors': formset.errors}, status=400)
        cutoff = timezone.now() - timedelta(days=PURGE_AFTER_DAYS)
        ids = [form.instance.pk for form in formset if form.instance.pk]
        deleted, _ = Invoice.objects.filter(pk__in=ids, issued_at__lt=cutoff).delete()
        return JsonResponse({'deleted': deleted})

from django.contrib.auth.tokens import default_token_generator
from django.core.mail import send_mail
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.views.generic import FormView

from app.accounts.forms import PasswordResetRequestForm
from app.accounts.models import User

RESET_BASE_URL = 'https://app.example.com/reset'


class PasswordResetRequestView(FormView):
    form_class = PasswordResetRequestForm
    template_name = 'accounts/reset_request.html'

    def form_valid(self, form):
        email = form.cleaned_data['email']
        user = User.objects.filter(email=email).first()
        if user is not None:
            token = default_token_generator.make_token(user)
            send_mail(
                'Reset your password',
                RESET_BASE_URL + '?token=' + token,
                'no-reply@example.com',
                [user.email],
            )
        return JsonResponse(
            {'detail': 'if the account exists, an email was sent'}
        )

import jwt
from django.conf import settings
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.accounts.repository import UserRepository
from app.db import get_session

router = APIRouter()


async def reset_session(session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)):
    yield session


@router.post('/auth/password-reset')
async def request_password_reset(
    email: str,
    session: AsyncSession = Depends(reset_session),
):
    repo = UserRepository(session)
    user = await repo.find_by_email(email)
    if user is None:
        return {'detail': 'if the account exists, an email was sent'}
    token = jwt.encode(
        {'sub': user.id, 'scope': 'password_reset'},
        settings.RESET_SECRET,
        algorithm='HS256',
    )
    return {
        'detail': 'reset link generated',
        'reset_token': token,
    }

import secrets

from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.views.generic import CreateView

from app.integrations.forms import ApiKeyForm
from app.integrations.models import ApiKey


class ApiKeyCreateView(CreateView):
    model = ApiKey
    form_class = ApiKeyForm

    def form_valid(self, form):
        api_key = form.save(commit=False)
        api_key.label = form.cleaned_data['label']
        api_key.secret = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        api_key.save()
        return JsonResponse(
            {
                'id': api_key.pk,
                'label': api_key.label,
                'secret_suffix': api_key.secret[-4:],
                'created': True,
            }
        )
